description:
Create a recurring wake-up schedule using a cron expression (UTC), keyed by a memory tag (memory_tag). Useful for periodic check-ins, heartbeats, monitoring ticks, and recurring reminders. Stash the follow-up context as a memory tagged with memory_tag, create a cron wake-up, then decide what to do on each run when the wake-up fires.

For platform liveness, a common pattern is a global heartbeat schedule (for example: tag=heartbeat:global, memory_tag=heartbeat:global). When present, the assistant can rely on periodic wake-ups to send check-ins, monitor long-running jobs, and detect stuck work.
embedding_description: Create a recurring wake-up on a cron cadence using memory_tag. Use for heartbeats, periodic monitoring, recurring reminders, and always-on ticks (including a global heartbeat like heartbeat:global). Store follow-up context as a memory tagged with memory_tag; each run retrieves the tagged memory and the model decides what to do. Cancel via clear_scheduled_actions_by_tag.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Confirmation of recurring cron schedule creation with schedule_id and next execution time
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: A recurring schedule has been created. If this is a user-facing check-in/heartbeat, consider telling the requester what cadence to expect. Retain the schedule_id or tags so you can cancel the schedule once it is no longer needed.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Creating a recurring wake-up schedule keyed by memory_tag
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError with 'cron_expression': invalid cron syntax or format. ValidationError with 'memory_tag': memory_tag is missing or invalid. SchedulerError: scheduling service unavailable or failed to register schedule.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For cron syntax errors: verify cron expression format (minute hour day month weekday). For memory_tag errors: provide a non-empty memory_tag and ensure the follow-up memory is tagged with it. For scheduler errors: verify the scheduling service is running.
